summary.title: Part 03 — June 1963: Robert Paine's Crowbar, Flying Starfish & the Discovery of Keystone Species and Trophic Cascades — Midpoint Twist

plates.quality_reason: Quality: readable faces (30-year-old zoologist Robert Treat Paine III at Mukkaw Bay in June 1963 prying purple Pisaster ochraceus starfish off an 8-metre rocky intertidal ledge with a steel crowbar and flinging them into the Pacific to discover keystone species in 1966–1969, dissolving to marine ecologist James A. Estes in the Aleutian Islands in 1974 observing sea otters controlling sea urchins to save kelp forests).
